---

🌟 Create a new Google Sheet with optional data, headers, and MARKDOWN FORMATTING v2.0!

⚠️ IMPORTANT: Markdown formatting is SPECIFIC TO THIS TOOL ONLY (google_sheets_create). Do NOT use this syntax in other tools like google_docs_create, gmail_send_email, etc. This is exclusively for Google Sheets cell formatting.

🎯 HOW IT WORKS:
1. Set parse_markdown=True to enable formatting
2. Add markdown codes to your data/headers
3. Tool converts markdown → Professional Google Sheets formatting
4. Result: Color-coded, aligned, formatted spreadsheet

⚡ v2.0 SYNTAX (COMPACT - RECOMMENDED - 53% SHORTER!):

📍 ALIGNMENT (parentheses at start of cell):
  (L)text  → Left-align cell
  (R)text  → Right-align cell
  (C)text  → Center-align cell
  Example: (R)$125,000  → Right-aligned number

🎨 TEXT COLORS (shortened, NO closing tag):
  [R]text   → Red 🔴 (errors, critical, blocked, negative)
  [G]text   → Green 🟢 (success, active, complete, positive)
  [B]text   → Blue 🔵 (info, neutral, standard)
  [P]text   → Purple 🟣 (special, VIP, important)
  [GR]text  → Gray ⚫ (inactive, archived, disabled)
  [BK]text  → Black (default text)
  Example: [G]Active  → Green text

🎨 BACKGROUND COLORS (curly braces, NO closing tag):
  {LR}text  → Light red background (errors, alerts, warnings)
  {LG}text  → Light green background (success, approved, good)
  {LB}text  → Light blue background (info, neutral, calm)
  {LP}text  → Light purple background (special, featured)
  {LGR}text → Light gray background (headers, inactive)
  Example: {LG}Approved  → Light green background

📏 STACKING ORDER (combine multiple formats):
  Format order: (ALIGN)[COLOR]{BACKGROUND}text
  
  Examples:
  • (R)[G]{LG}+16%         → Right-aligned, green text, light green bg
  • (C)[R]{LR}BLOCKED      → Center-aligned, red text, light red bg
  • (L)[B]Premium Widgets  → Left-aligned, blue text
  • (R)$125,000            → Right-aligned (no color)
  • [G]Active              → Green text (no alignment specified)

📝 v1.2 SYNTAX (VERBOSE - STILL SUPPORTED FOR COMPATIBILITY):
  **bold**                      → Bold text
  *italic*                      → Italic text
  # Header                      → Large header (18pt, bold)
  [RED]text[/RED]               → Red text (verbose with closing tag)
  [BG:LIGHTGREEN]text[/BG]      → Light green background (verbose)
  
  Note: v2.0 and v1.2 can be mixed in same sheet!

🎛️ FORMATTING CONTROL PARAMETERS:
  • parse_markdown: Enable/disable markdown (default: False)
  • auto_borders: Auto borders on all cells (default: True)

✅ WHEN TO USE MARKDOWN:
  ✓ Sales/financial reports (green=profit, red=loss, alignment for numbers)
  ✓ Status dashboards (color-coded states: active/blocked/pending)
  ✓ Patient records (priority levels, status indicators)
  ✓ Inventory alerts (stock levels: ok/low/critical)
  ✓ Project tracking (task status with visual indicators)
  ✓ Any spreadsheet needing visual emphasis or professional formatting

💡 QUICK EXAMPLES:

1. Sales Report with v2.0:
   headers=['(C)# Product', '(R)**Q3**', '(R)**Q4**', '(R)**Change**']
   data=[
     ['(L)[G]Premium', '(R)$145K', '(R)$168K', '(R)[G]{LG}+16%'],
     ['(L)Standard', '(R)$85K', '(R)$78K', '(R)[R]{LR}-8%']
   ]

2. Status Dashboard:
   headers=['(L)# Task', '(C)**Status**', '(R)**Priority**']
   data=[
     ['(L)API Integration', '(C)[G]{LG}Complete', '(R)High'],
     ['(L)UI Redesign', '(C)[R]{LR}Blocked', '(R)High']
   ]

3. Simple Color Coding (v1.2):
   headers=['# Product', '**Status**']
   data=[
     ['Widget Pro', '[GREEN]In Stock[/GREEN]'],
     ['Widget Lite', '[RED]Out of Stock[/RED]']
   ]

🎯 CHARACTER SAVINGS:
  v1.2: [RED]Critical[/RED]    → 21 characters
  v2.0: [R]Critical             → 11 characters (48% shorter!)
  
  v1.2: [BG:LIGHTGREEN]Active[/BG] → 29 characters  
  v2.0: {LG}Active                   → 10 characters (66% shorter!)

⚠️ REMEMBER: Only use markdown when parse_markdown=True. Default is False for backward compatibility.

headers.description: Optional header row. Examples: ['Name', 'Age', 'City'] (plain) OR ['# Patient Name', '**Status**', '**Priority**'] (with markdown). Use markdown for visual hierarchy and emphasis.

data.description: Optional 2D array of data. Examples: [['John', 25, 'NYC']] (plain) OR [['**John Doe**', '[GREEN]Active[/GREEN]', '**High**']] (with markdown). Use markdown for emphasis, colors, and formatting.

parse_markdown.description: Enable markdown formatting (default: False). Set to True to convert markdown syntax into professional Google Sheets formatting. Creates color-coded, formatted spreadsheets automatically. 96% time savings vs manual formatting. Use for dashboards, reports, status boards, and any sheet needing visual emphasis.

header_row_background.description: Apply gray background to header row (default: True). Set to False to control header formatting entirely with markdown (e.g., use [BG:LIGHTBLUE] for custom header backgrounds). Only applies when headers are provided.

auto_borders.description: Automatically add borders to all cells (default: True). Set to False for borderless sheets. Borders help create professional-looking tables and improve readability.

returns.description: Created spreadsheet with ID, shareable URL, title, rows written, and markdown_parsed status
